raw_segments.text: Five days later, all had heard that he was ill and that his life was in danger.
The nature of his illness, I can't explain.
They said it was an affection of the heart.
But it became known that the doctors had been induced by his wife to investigate his mental
condition also, and had come to the conclusion that it was a case of insanity.
I betrayed nothing, though people ran to question me.
